# Detailed Bibliography — RGBT Object Detection

Detailed companion to the [README](README.md): every entry with a one-sentence contribution and notes, in the README's technical-route classification (core list first, appendix second). Generated from papers.csv.

## Surveys & Benchmarks

| Paper | Link | Tags | Contribution | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Physical Adversarial Clothing Evades Visible-Thermal Detectors via Non-Overlapping RGB-T Pattern — Zhu, Zeng, Hu, Zhu, Hu, 2026, CVPR | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/papers/Zhu_Physical_Adversarial_Clothing_Evades_Visible-Thermal_Detectors_via_Non-Overlapping_RGB-T_Pattern_CVPR_2026_paper.pdf) · [Code](https://github.com/zxp555/RGBT-Clothing) | corruption | Physical adversarial clothing whose visible and thermal patterns are mutually non-overlapping (NORP), jointly optimised on a 3D RGB-T human model with fusion-stage ensembling for transfer to unseen detectors. | An attack paper, not a detector: catalogued in the core list (Surveys & Benchmarks) as a physical-robustness evaluation of paired RGB-T detectors across fusion architectures. CVPR 2026, pp. 13356-13365 (pages per citing references); also arXiv:2605.04675. |
| UAV-CB: A Complex-Background RGB-T Dataset and Local Frequency Bridge Network for UAV Detection — Huang et al., 2026, CVPR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17492) | benchmark; aerial; frequency-domain | A complex-background RGB-T UAV-detection dataset (3,442 pairs across five background types, incl. camouflage scenes) with LFBNet, a local frequency bridge that aligns and fuses the two modalities in local frequency space. | Dataset/benchmark paper with a baseline method; the detection targets are UAVs themselves in cluttered low-altitude scenes. CVPR 2026 (CVF supplemental on file). No official code found. |
| WiSE-OD — Medeiros, Belal, Aminbeidokhti, Granger, Pedersoli, 2026, WACV | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18925) · [Code](https://github.com/heitorrapela/wiseod) | degraded-modality; benchmark | Weight-space ensembling for OOD RGB-T detection; introduces LLVIP-C / FLIR-C. | 全文精读（以 arXiv v2 为准）：提出 LLVIP-C / FLIR-C 评测——在 IR 测试集上施 14 种 ImageNet-C 式腐蚀（LLVIP severity 5、FLIR severity 2，因其 JPEG 图像经不起 5 档），以干净 AP50 + mPC 评分；另有 M3FD 真实偏移划分（白天训练的 IR 模型，测雾/夜/雨/室内）。方法 WiSE-OD 为权重空间插值：(1−λ)·θ_RGB^COCO + λ·θ_IR（端点为全量微调或线性探测），λ=0.5 为默认且刻意不在目标数据上调参；一次权重合并，零额外训练与推理成本。Faster R-CNN 在 LLVIP-C 上 mPC 75.83（LP 变体）对全量微调 56.40，干净 AP50 96.24 高于两个父模型；λ 扫描中干净 AP50 在 0.5 达峰、mPC 在 0.3 达峰（76.98）；仅线性探测本身就是强鲁棒基线（mPC 70.96）。M3FD 的标题增益是 YOLOv8 的（相对 FT 的 mAP：雨 +10.8、雾 +7.2、夜 +7.1，平均 +6.3），而 Faster R-CNN 夜间反降（29.4 → 27.9）。集成继承而非治愈父模型失效（severity 5 对比度腐蚀：FT 0.00、WiSE-OD 10.57、LP 51.53）。部署的检测器只用 IR（RGB 只是预训练来源），故本文测的是单模态迁移鲁棒性、不是配对融合退化。代码：heitorrapela/wiseod。 |
| Fusion Meets Diverse Conditions: A High-diversity Benchmark and Baseline for UAV-based Multimodal Object Detection with Condition Cues — Chen et al., 2025, ICCV | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2025/papers/Chen_Fusion_Meets_Diverse_Conditions_A_High-diversity_Benchmark_and_Baseline_for_ICCV_2025_paper.pdf) | benchmark; aerial; degraded-modality | Introduces ATR-UMOD, a UAV RGB-IR dataset with 11 categories and six per-pair condition attributes (altitude, angle, time, weather, illumination, scenario), plus the prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion baseline PCDF. | Training/test split of 11,850/1,503 pairs with conditions annotated, enabling condition-specific robustness evaluation. |
| Infrared and Visible Image Fusion: From Data Compatibility to Task Adaption — Liu, Wu, Liu, Wang, Jiang, Ma, Zhong, Fan, Liu, 2025, IEEE TPAMI | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10761) | survey | Comprehensive IVIF survey organized around task adaptation. | Authoritative section anchor from the TarDAL/M3FD group. |
| Visible-Thermal Tiny Object Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Baselines (RGBT-Tiny) — Ying et al., 2025, IEEE TPAMI | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14482) · [Code](https://github.com/XinyiYing/RGBT-Tiny) | aerial | RGBT-Tiny benchmark: 115 paired sequences, 93K frames, 1.2M annotations in 7 categories (over 81% of objects under 16x16 px), plus the SAFit evaluation measure and extensive baseline evaluations. | The standard tiny-object RGBT benchmark; also a datasets.md entry. |
| MSOD-Bench: Optimizing Multispectral Object Detection — Zhou, Cheng, Fang, Zhang, Yan, Jia, Xu, Wang, Cao, 2024, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18288) | benchmark | Standardized re-implementation/benchmark of 20+ RGB-T detectors. | Fair-comparison framing; guards against cherry-picked baseline numbers. |
| Misaligned Visible-Thermal Object Detection: A Drone-based Benchmark and Baseline (DVTOD) — Song et al., 2024, IEEE TIV | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/TIV.2024.3398429) · [Code](https://github.com/VDT-2048/DVTOD) | benchmark; aerial; alignment | Drone-based benchmark of deliberately misaligned visible-thermal pairs with a baseline detector, quantifying misalignment sensitivity. | The misalignment counterpart to the aligned DroneVehicle benchmark referenced throughout the list. |
| When Pedestrian Detection Meets Multi-Modal Learning: Generalist Model and Benchmark Dataset (MMPedestron) — Zhang et al., 2024, ECCV | [Paper](https://www.ecva.net/papers/eccv_2024/papers_ECCV/papers/06487.pdf) · [Code](https://github.com/BubblyYi/MMPedestron) | benchmark; pedestrian; foundation-model | A generalist pedestrian detector handling dynamic combinations of RGB, IR, depth, LiDAR and event inputs, plus the MMPD benchmark aggregating existing datasets and a new RGB-Event set. | Handles missing/dynamic modality combinations by design, unlike fixed-pair specialist detectors. |

## Pixel-Level Fusion for Detection

| Paper | Link | Tags | Contribution | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DDFD: Diffusion-Based Denoising Fusion for Object Detection in Infrared-Visible Images — Dang et al., 2025, ACM MM | [Paper](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3746027.3755183) | image-fusion; task-coupled; degraded-modality | Treats image fusion as a diffusion denoising process with an image-adaptive visible-enhancement module, jointly optimized with the detector (ACM MM 2025, pp. 1452-1461). | Experiments on M3FD, DroneVehicle and VEDAI, including challenging-weather conditions. The Pixel-Level line's first diffusion-based entry. |
| E2E-MFD: Towards End-to-End Synchronous Multimodal Fusion Detection — Zhang et al., 2024, NeurIPS | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.09323) · [Code](https://github.com/icey-zhang/EfficientMFD) | image-fusion; task-coupled; aerial | Single-phase end-to-end joint optimization of image fusion and detection with a gradient-matrix strategy for shared parameters, avoiding staged sub-optimal training. | Reports +3.9 mAP50 on M3FD and +2.0 on DroneVehicle over prior fusion-detection pipelines. Code repo is the authors' EfficientMFD repo. |
| CDDFuse — Zhao, Bai, Zhang, Zhang, Xu, Lin, Timofte, Van Gool, 2023, CVPR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.14461) | image-fusion; task-coupled | Correlation-driven dual-branch decomposition fusion, incl. downstream detection. | Task-coupled fusion line (fusion-for-detection). |
| MetaFusion — Zhao, Xie, Zhao, He, Lu, 2023, CVPR | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR52729.2023.01341) | image-fusion; task-coupled | Detection-guided meta-feature embedding mutually promoting fusion and detection. | Supports the manuscript's task-constrained motivation. |
| SuperYOLO: Super Resolution Assisted Object Detection in Multimodal Remote Sensing Imagery — Zhang et al., 2023, IEEE TGRS | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2023.3258666) · [Code](https://github.com/icey-zhang/SuperYOLO) | image-fusion; aerial; yolo; efficiency | Pixel-level multimodal fusion inside a YOLOv5-style detector plus a super-resolution auxiliary branch (removed at inference) to recover small-object detail. | One of the most-cited YOLO-family multispectral detectors (VEDAI); a detection-native pixel-level entry. |
| DetFusion: A Detection-driven Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Network — Sun et al., 2022, ACM MM | [Paper](https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3503161.3547902) · [Code](https://github.com/SunYM2020/DetFusion) | image-fusion; task-coupled | Modality-specific detectors supply object attention maps through a shared attention module that biases the fusion decoder toward object regions (ACM MM 2022, pp. 4003-4011). | Authors Sun, Cao, Zhu, Hu - the Tianjin group behind UA-CMDet and CMPD. A standard task-driven fusion-detection baseline. |
| TarDAL: Target-aware Dual Adversarial Learning and a Multi-scenario Multi-Modality Benchmark to Fuse Infrared and Visible for Object Detection — Liu, Fan, Huang, Wu, Liu, Zhong, Luo, 2022, CVPR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.16220) · [Code](https://github.com/JinyuanLiu-CV/TarDAL) | image-fusion; task-coupled | Target-aware dual adversarial learning that fuses infrared and visible images for detection; introduced the M3FD benchmark. | Classic task-coupled fusion entry; the M3FD dataset paper. |

| DyFCLT: Dynamic Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Modal Learning Transformer for Multimodal Tiny Object Detection — Li, Dai, Li, Yao, Jiang, Zheng, 2026, CVPR | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/papers/Li_DyFCLT_Dynamic_Frequency-Decoupled_Cross-Modal_Learning_Transformer_for_Multimodal_Tiny_Object_CVPR_2026_paper.pdf) | transformer; frequency-domain; aerial | Dynamic frequency-band decoupled cross-modal attention (DFCA) plus Selective Smoothing Enhancement (SSE) for RGBT tiny object detection. | Frequency-domain RGBT tiny-object detector: DFCA decomposes Q/K/V features into B=3 dynamic frequency subbands for band-wise cross-modal attention; SSE suppresses background noise and guides multiscale upsampling. RGBT-Tiny AP 48.2 / AP50 69.1 / APs_t 41.3 (vs M2D-LIF 38.7/54.9/29.0); RGBTDronePerson AP50 61.0; FLIR AP 45.0 / AP50 84.1. CVPR 2026, pp. 11313–11323 (pages per citing references). |
| Modality-Decoupled RGB-Thermal Object Detector via Query Fusion — Tian et al., 2026, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08458) | detr; transformer; dual-stream | MDQF runs two independent DETR-like branches for RGB and thermal and exchanges selected high-quality queries between refinement stages (Query Fusion), balancing complementarity against modality separation. | The decoupled design also lets each branch be optimised on unpaired single-modality images. Same group as the sparse cross-modality fusion entry (arXiv:2606.30215). No official code found. |
| Thermal-Det: Language-Guided Cross-Modal Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Thermal Object Detection — Ranasinghe et al., 2026, CVPR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10130) | foundation-model; distillation | First LLM-supervised open-vocabulary thermal detector: builds over a million synthetic thermal-aligned samples from GroundingCap-1M and distils from a frozen RGB teacher on unlabelled paired RGB-T data. | Thermal-only at inference; paired RGB-T data serves training-time distillation only. +2-4% AP over existing open-vocabulary detectors on thermal benchmarks reported. CVPR 2026 per arXiv comments, with the CVF supplemental on file. No official code found. |
| M-SpecGene: Generalized Foundation Model for RGBT Multispectral Vision — Zhou et al., 2025, ICCV | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2025/html/Zhou_M-SpecGene_Generalized_Foundation_Model_for_RGBT_Multispectral_Vision_ICCV_2025_paper.html) · [Code](https://github.com/CalayZhou/M-SpecGene) | foundation-model | Self-supervised RGBT foundation model using a Cross-Modality Structural Sparsity metric and GMM-based progressive masking to pretrain modality-invariant representations. | Validated across eleven datasets and four RGBT downstream tasks including detection (ICCV 2025, pp. 7861-7872). The dedicated RGBT pretraining counterpart to UniRGB-IR. |
| SAM-Guided Semantic Knowledge Fusion for Visible-Infrared Object Detection — Li et al., 2025, ACM MM | [Paper](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3746027.3755718) · [Code](https://github.com/liting1018/SemFusion) | foundation-model | Injects SAM-derived semantic knowledge into visible-infrared feature fusion to guide object-level complementarity (ACM MM 2025, pp. 8835-8844). | Same UESTC group as PFGF; the two are distinct methods and venues. |

Its VEDAI benchmark is RGB + near-infrared (NIR), not RGB-thermal. |
| UniRGB-IR — Yuan, Cui, Zhao, Wang, Fu, Yang, Wei, 2025, ACM MM | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.17360) | foundation-model; adapter | Adapter injection of RGB-IR fusion into a frozen ViT foundation model. | Foundation-model line; FLIR mAP 44.1 / LLVIP 63.2. |

| CF-Deformable DETR: An End-to-End Alignment-Free Model for Weakly Aligned Visible-Infrared Object Detection — Fu et al., 2024, IJCAI | [Paper](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/0084.pdf) · [Code](https://github.com/116508/CF-Deformable-DETR) | detr; alignment; transformer | Alignment-free DETR whose cross-modal deformable attention maps points between modalities directly, guided by a point-level feature consistency loss in hyperbolic space. | Maintains accuracy across varying synthetic offset degrees on KAIST, FLIR and LLVIP. The DETR cluster's first alignment-free representative. |
| DAMSDet — Guo, Gao, Liu, Meng, Gao, 2024, ECCV | [Paper](https://eccv.ecva.net/virtual/2024/poster/801) · [Code](https://github.com/gjj45/DAMSDet) | transformer; detr | Competitive query selection + deformable cross-attention in a DETR RGB-T detector. | SOTA DETR representative on M3FD/FLIR/LLVIP (FLIR mAP 49.3, LLVIP mAP 69.6). |
| GM-DETR — Xiao, Meng, Wu, Xu, He, Li, 2024, CVPR Workshops | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2024W/JRDB/papers/Xiao_GM-DETR_Generalized_Muiltispectral_DEtection_TRansformer_with_Efficient_Fusion_Encoder_for_CVPRW_2024_paper.pdf) | transformer; detr; efficiency | Lightweight DETR-style RGB-T detector. | Additional DETR-line data point on FLIR + LLVIP. |
| ICAFusion: Iterative Cross-Attention Guided Feature Fusion for Multispectral Object Detection — Shen, Chen, Liu, Zuo, Fan, Yang, 2024, Pattern Recognition | [Paper](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10225383) · [Code](https://github.com/chanchanchan97/ICAFusion) | cross-attention | Iterative cross-attention guided feature fusion for multispectral object detection. | Established cross-attention fusion reference, widely used as a comparison baseline (LLVIP, M3FD). |
| Improving RGB-Infrared Object Detection with Cascade Alignment-Guided Transformer (CAGT) — Yuan, Shi, Wang, Wang, Wei, 2024, Information Fusion | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.inffus.2024.102246) | alignment; aerial; transformer; cross-attention | Cascades region alignment (TSRA-style) with a complementary fusion transformer inside an RoI detection head; evaluated on DroneVehicle and KAIST. | Transformer-era successor to TSFADet and a sibling of C2Former; strengthens the alignment-aware cluster. |
| Cross-Modality Fusion Transformer (CFT) — Fang, Han, Wang, 2021, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.00273) | cross-attention; transformer | YOLOv5-based transformer cross-modal fusion for RGB-T detection. | Canonical transformer-fusion baseline on FLIR + LLVIP; appears in all recent comparison tables. |
| Guided Attentive Feature Fusion for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (GAFF) — Zhang, Fromont, Lefèvre, Avignon, 2021, WACV | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/WACV2021/html/Zhang_Guided_Attentive_Feature_Fusion_for_Multispectral_Pedestrian_Detection_WACV_2021_paper.html) | pedestrian; cross-attention; efficiency | Inter- and intra-modality attention modules dynamically weigh and fuse multispectral features at low computational cost. | A widely used comparison point in CFT-era papers; an efficiency-conscious attention baseline. |
| Cross-Modality Interactive Attention Network for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (CIAN) — Zhang et al., 2019, Information Fusion | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.inffus.2018.09.015) | pedestrian; cross-attention | Interactive attention module encoding inter-modality correlations to recalibrate channel responses of halfway features before fusion. | Early, heavily cited cross-modal attention design that predates and motivates the transformer fusion line. |

| LER-YOLO: Reliability-Aware Expert Routing for Misaligned RGB-Infrared UAV Detection — Hou et al., 2026, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20667) | alignment; expert-routing; aerial; yolo | Uncertainty-aware target alignment resamples visible features onto the infrared reference, and a reliability-guided sparse mixture-of-experts routes among RGB-dominant, IR-dominant and interaction experts. | 面向未对齐 RGB-IR UAV 检测：U-TA 估计稠密形变场对齐 RGB 特征，并以对齐后两路特征的 L1 一致性自监督出空间可靠性图 R；融合前先以 R 软门控 RGB 特征，再由内容路由器对 RGB 主导 / IR 主导 / 交互三专家做软加权（默认 top-k=3 即全选，无硬路由）。MBU 基准受控协议内优于静态融合，但相对增益随合成平移增大而消失（40 px 时为 0）；消融显示无可靠性引导的 MoE 已拿走大部分增益。仅评测几何错位，无模态损坏 / 缺失评测，无测试时适应；补充表 S1–S3 未随 arXiv 发布。 |

| Weakly Aligned Feature Fusion for Multimodal Object Detection — Zhang et al., 2025, IEEE TNNLS | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/TNNLS.2021.3105143) | alignment; dual-stream | Journal extension of the AR-CNN line: weakly aligned feature fusion generalised from pedestrian detection to multimodal object detection. | Bridges pedestrian alignment work and general detection. Early access 2021; issue (vol. 36) published 2025 per Crossref. |

| DEYOLO — Chen, Wang, Guo, Zhu, He, Liu, Yuan, 2024, ICPR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04931) | yolo; dual-stream | Dual semantic/spatial enhancement modules on YOLOv8 dual streams. | YOLO-line comparator on M3FD + LLVIP. |

## Feature-Level Fusion — State-Space Models (Mamba)

| Paper | Link | Tags | Contribution | Notes |

## Feature-Level Fusion — Quality- & Conflict-Aware Fusion

| Paper | Link | Tags | Contribution | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridging Multimodal Fusion and Expert Routing via Spectral Reliability Descriptors for Robust Object Detection — Wu, 2026, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01173) | quality-aware; expert-routing; degraded-modality; aerial | Parameter-free 7-D spectral reliability descriptors computed at fusion time drive both spectral reliability fusion (SRF) and reliability-conditioned expert routing (RCER) for RGB-infrared detection. | 全文精读：在对齐后的 RGB/IR 特征谱（P4/P5）上无参数、停梯度地算出 7 维光谱可靠性描述子（分带能量、幅度比、相位一致性、跨谱相关），一次算出、两处复用——SRF 中门控融合（在光谱交互特征与保守的双路均值回退之间混合），RCER 中为 top-2 任务专家（Texture / Saliency / Recovery + 常开共享专家）路由，基座为 DEIM/D-FINE。受控消融（5 种子）：换路由信号的收益大于换专家结构（+0.7~0.9 对 +0.6~0.8）；DroneVehicle 六种单一强度合成退化的平均保持率 95.0%，拼接基线 87.9%（模态丢弃一项 90.9%）。描述子为全局量，按设计不处理空间非平稳可靠性；其跨方法主表为转录数字、非同配方重跑。 |
| Distribution-Aligned Multimodal Fusion for Robust Object Detection — Hao, Pu, Wang, She, 2026, CVPR | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/papers/Hao_Distribution-Aligned_Multimodal_Fusion_for_Robust_Object_Detection_CVPR_2026_paper.pdf) | degraded-modality; quality-aware | Freezes a pretrained detector and trains only a lightweight fusion module that aligns fused features to the pretrained (clean) feature distribution, generalizing to unseen degradation types. | 全文精读：冻结 ViT-Base + DETR 检测器（86M），只训融合模块（13M），以负对数似然损失把融合特征的 [CLS] 对齐到 P_normal——由 5k 张目标域正常图像特征拟合的 K=8 对角 GMM（并非预训练分布）。跨退化协议（只用过曝训练）：对齐到 P_normal 能泛化到未见退化（夜间 76.8、模糊 40.6 mAP50），对齐到退化分布则已见项略胜、未见项明显落后（67.5 / 28.5）。三集均为最佳（LLVIP 98.1、FLIR 79.5、DroneVehicle 57.8 mAP50），但过曝保持率仅约正常水平的 48%。无模态缺失评测（默认 IR 始终完好）；退化生成参数未报告；未与输入级质量衰减基线比较。 |
| InfraNet: Quality-Aware RGB Guidance for Infrared Object Detection — Feng, Zhu, Yang, Xu, Ren, Yang, Liu, Zhang, Wang, Yang, Zhang, 2026, ECCV | [Paper](https://eccv.ecva.net/virtual/2026/poster/3873) | quality-aware; missing-modality | IR-centric asymmetric detector whose QualGate module learns a task-oriented control signal to suppress unreliable RGB guidance during cross-modal training; supports RGB-IR or IR-only deployment. | 全文精读：非对称设计——IR 为主路，RGB 降级为训练期特权指导，由 QualGate 控制：单个标量 q（GAP + 瓶颈 MLP + sigmoid，无质量监督、纯任务驱动）按 q 缩放 RGB 贡献，并以 α(q)=clip(1.5−q; 1.0, 1.5) 反向放大 IR。InfraNet-IR 推理时整支删除 RGB（参数与时延与纯 IR 基线完全相同，却靠 RGB 指导训练在 M3FD 上 +1.4/+1.8 mAP50/mAP）；InfraNet-RGB-IR 保留双路并在线门控。受控退化只覆盖 RGB 的雾与亮度（五档、无物理定义、IR 固定），且 q 在雾下的动态范围极小（约 0.007）。无 IR 退化、无缺失率曲线；结果为单次运行、无方差。 |
| EI²Det: Edge-Guided Illumination-Aware Interactive Learning for Visible-Infrared Object Detection — Hu et al., 2025, IEEE TCSVT | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/TCSVT.2025.3539625) · [Code](https://github.com/hukefy/EI2Det) | quality-aware | Edge-guided, illumination-aware interactive learning between the two streams for visible-infrared detection, with the accompanying MFAD dataset. | Full author list verified via Crossref (Hu, He, Li, Zhao, Chen, Kang), TCSVT Jul 2025. |
| Efficient Multispectral Object Detection with Attentive Feature Aggregation Leveraging Zero-Shot Implicit Illumination Guidance — Xiong et al., 2025, Information Fusion | [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.inffus.2025.102939) | efficiency; quality-aware | Attentive feature aggregation steered by zero-shot implicit illumination estimates, targeting efficient multispectral detection (Information Fusion, Jun 2025). | Journal record and author list verified via Crossref. An efficiency-focused entry in the otherwise accuracy-only Quality subsection. |
| Learning a Robust RGB-Thermal Detector for Extreme Modality Imbalance — Tian, Yang, Zhu, Wang, He, 2025, Pattern Recognition Letters | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22154) | degraded-modality; quality-aware; modality-imbalance | Base-and-auxiliary training framework for extreme modality imbalance: a quality-aware interaction module (per-stage single-channel spatial masks, cross-addition at CSP stages 3-5) plus training-time pseudo-degradation (global affine x_hat = b + c*x, c~U(0,0.7), prob. 0.3, one modality) and EMA base detector with L2 logit consistency; inference uses the EMA base only. | 全文精读（PRL 196:1–8）：KAIST 干净 LAMR All 8.63（非 SOTA：CPFM 6.62），RGB-only 31.35（CPFM 46.7 / YOLOX-RGBT 64.55）；FLIR AP50 干净 78.8，TIR-only 75.2 对 43.3。测试时高斯噪声 σ=20：8.86/9.56 对 YOLOX-RGBT 的 16.77/25.15。消融：交互模块单独使用反伤失衡 OOD；伪退化单独使用损害干净收敛；EMA 框架同时修复两者。局限：退化族只有一种全局仿射（无模糊/JPEG/局部退化），缺失以对比度降为零模拟，corrupted 与 missing 不分开评，参数 72.18M（作者承认对部署过大）。与模态接管研究最接近的先行工作：属训练期重加权、非推理期修正。 |
| Mixed Patch Visible-Infrared Modality Agnostic Object Detection (MiPa) — Medeiros et al., 2025, WACV | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/WACV2025/html/Medeiros_Mixed_Patch_Visible-Infrared_Modality_Agnostic_Object_Detection_WACV_2025_paper.html) · [Code](https://github.com/heitorrapela/MiPa) | missing-modality; modality-imbalance; transformer | Trains a single shared transformer encoder on patch-mixed RGB/IR inputs so the detector needs only one modality at inference, countering modality dominance. | 模态无关检测：训练期将对齐的可见光 / 红外图像对逐块互补采样（比例 ρ）拼成单幅马赛克图喂共享编码器，逐 batch 从 U(0,1) 重抽 ρ 的 Variable 方案最好（LLVIP 双路均值 AP50 93.00）；推理期只输入单模态，模型无双路推理模式。评测仅覆盖模态缺失（部署侧决定），无任何模态损坏 / 退化评测；RGB 侧仍低于 RGB 专门模型 1.77 点，无最坏情况保证。其自带整图级混合基线 Both 明显更差，可作整图级混合买不到模态平衡的对照。 |

Official repository linked from the paper (code upload marked in progress there). A training-side companion to the negative-fusion line (cf. MEFormer, QMF in the appendix). |
| Rethinking Multi-modal Object Detection from the Perspective of Mono-Modality Feature Learning (M2D-LIF) — Zhao et al., 2025, ICCV | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.11780) · [Code](https://github.com/Zhao-Tian-yi/M2D-LIF) | modality-imbalance; distillation | Identifies 'fusion degradation' from insufficient mono-modality learning in joint training; counters it with mono-modality distillation plus a local illumination-aware fusion module. | 提出并命名 Fusion Degradation（单模态可检出、融合反而漏检），归因于联合训练下单模态骨干学习不充分（冻结骨干线性探针为据）；以每模态冻结的单模态教师做模态内蒸馏 + SimAM 注意力图引导的跨模态蒸馏（推理时教师与蒸馏移除、零开销），LIF 光照权重构造性限制在 [0.3, 0.7]，任一模态不能被完全压掉。干净基准成绩：FLIR mAP 46.1、LLVIP 70.8、DroneVehicle mAP50 81.4；无损坏 / 缺失模态鲁棒性评测。原文未评测 RGBT-Tiny（其 AP 38.7 出自 DyFCLT 的对比表）。 |

| SM3Det: A Unified Model for Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Object Detection — Li et al., 2026, AAAI | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.20665) · [Code](https://github.com/zcablii/SM3Det) | aerial; expert-routing | Single unified detector trained jointly across multi-modal remote-sensing datasets (including RGB and infrared) with a grid-level sparse MoE backbone and cross-task optimization balancing. | Scope note: unifies per-modality datasets (RGB / IR / SAR) in one model rather than fusing paired VIS-thermal inputs; appendix as a unified-model reference (AAAI 2026). |
| MoME: Resilient Sensor Fusion via Multi-Modal Expert Fusion — Park, Kim, Kim, Choi, 2025, CVPR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.19776) | expert-routing; degraded-modality; lidar-camera | Per-query routing among camera/LiDAR/fused experts by local feature quality. | Strongest analogue of region-dependent takeover (routing, not correction; 3D driving). |
| MEFormer — Cha, Joo, Park, Lee, Kim, Kim, 2024, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.19156) | negative-fusion; degraded-modality | Defines and mitigates "negative fusion" from defective modalities. | 全文精读：nuScenes 上的相机–LiDAR 3D 检测（基座 CMT）。针对 LiDAR 过度依赖与负融合（弱/噪模态污染另一模态的正确信息）：(i) MOAD——同一解码器跑三条分支（双模 / 仅 LiDAR / 仅相机，仅模态位置编码不同），各分支独立监督、等权重；(ii) PME——对三分支的框特征做带邻近偏置的交叉注意力集成（偏置来自 BEV 中心距离，不估计模态质量）。缺失模态测试时 PME 被禁用，故缺失鲁棒性全部来自 MOAD。干净验证集 73.9 NDS / 71.5 mAP；仅相机 48.0 / 42.5（CMT 44.7 / 38.3；BEVFusion 仅相机 mAP 崩至 0.2）；退化场景全表最佳但仍远低于干净水平（夜间 mAP 43.7）。「防止负融合」只是经验性主张——无形式保证、无负融合指标、无显式模态丢弃。 |
| Multimodal Fusion on Low-quality Data: A Comprehensive Survey — Zhang, Wei, Han, Fu, Peng, Deng, Hu, Xu, Wen, Hu, Zhang, 2024, arXiv | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.18947) | survey; degraded-modality; missing-modality | Taxonomy separating noisy, incomplete, imbalanced, quality-varying multimodal data. | Cleanest citation legitimizing the corrupted ≠ missing distinction. |
| DynMM — Xue & Marculescu, 2023, CVPR Workshops | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.00102) | dynamic-fusion; efficiency | On-the-fly gating over modality and fusion-level computation paths. | Dynamic-fusion precedent (efficiency-motivated). |
| Provable Dynamic Fusion for Low-Quality Multimodal Data (QMF) — Zhang, Wu, Zhang, Hu, Fu, Zhou, Peng, 2023, ICML | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.02050) | quality-aware; degraded-modality | Energy-based uncertainty drives dynamic decision-level fusion weights, with guarantees. | 全文精读：带形式化保证的质量感知动态融合——但保证只覆盖分类。按模态不确定性（能量分数）对决策级融合加权，并以历史损失排序正则强制实现其所假设的「不确定性–损失正相关」。定理 2：当动态权重的期望等于静态权重、且权重与逐模态损失的 Pearson 相关非正时，动态融合的泛化界优于静态融合。实验全部为分类（NYU Depth V2、SUN RGB-D、FOOD-101、MVSA；50% 模态加高斯噪声）：最重腐蚀下四集均为最佳（如 NYU 平均 55.60），但干净 NYU 上反低于 TMC（70.09 对 71.06）。其前提（二分类、逻辑损失、决策级加权、双模态）按原文表述不能迁移到检测。 |
| Trusted Multi-View Classification (TMC) — Han, Zhang, Fu, Zhou, 2021, ICLR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.02051) | evidential | Evidential per-view quality assessment with Dempster–Shafer fusion. | Foundational trusted/quality-aware fusion citation. |

## Appendix: Test-Time Adaptation, Intervention & Amortized Optimization

| Paper | Link | Tags | Contribution | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CD-Buffer: Complementary Dual-Buffer Framework for Test-Time Adaptation in Adverse Weather Object Detection — Song, Kim, Hwang, 2026, CVPR | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/papers/Song_CD-Buffer_Complementary_Dual-Buffer_Framework_for_Test-Time_Adaptation_in_Adverse_Weather_CVPR_2026_paper.pdf) · [Code](https://github.com/wkfsksdl99/cd_buffer) | test-time-adaptation; corruption | Couples additive (feature refinement) and subtractive (domain-sensitive channel removal) test-time adaptation paradigms in a dual-buffer framework, balanced per channel by a unified feature-level discrepancy measure. | 全文精读：面向恶劣天气的单模态 RGB 检测测试时自适应（Faster R-CNN + ResNet-50）。通道级域差异 D（当前批次特征与离线源统计的距离，图像级 + 实例级两路）同时驱动两个互补缓冲：减性缓冲的通道掩码 L1 正则按 D 加权（偏移重的通道更易被剪除），加性适配器对各通道的补偿强度则取同一掩码分数反转得到的逆软掩码——同一把差异尺子同时决定剪与补。适应信号为源统计对齐损失（不用熵、不用伪标签）。KITTI fog 50m：21.27 → 44.80 mAP50；雾强度阶梯上的持续 TTA 平均 55.66，高于 WHW 的 50.17；但并非全胜（中等雨量与 ACDC 雪一项分别落后 WHW 与 BufferTTA）。需随模型携带源统计且依赖批次估计；通道剪除依赖 BN 结构。 |
| Smoothing the Shift: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation under Complex Multimodal Noises — Guo, Jin, 2025, ICLR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.02616) · [Code](https://github.com/zrguo/SuMi) | test-time-adaptation; degraded-modality | SuMi targets wild multi-modal test-time adaptation: IQR smoothing against abrupt distribution shifts, unimodal-guided selection of low-entropy information-rich samples, and mutual-information sharing across modalities. | 全文精读：定义多模态 wild TTA——弱 OOD（单模态受损）、强 OOD（双模同时受损、单模缺失、缺失+受损的 Mix）与混合流，评测于音视频分类（CAV-MAE；Kinetics50-C / VGGSound-C）。核心是平滑适应轨迹：IQR 样本门控（在融合表示上按四分位距选样、区间随迭代放宽，先易后难）；单模态辅助筛选（只留真正需要双模态的样本：多模态熵低、但单模态熵之和不能太低）；互信息共享损失（把单模态预测分布拉向互补模态与融合分布的平均，强 OOD 下只开前一半迭代）。Kinetics50-C 强 OOD 平均 33.4，Tent 仅 11.2、源模型 30.0；消融中 IQR 平滑单项贡献最大（31.7 → 45.1）。仅限分类；缺失只作类型、未作剂量（无缺失率曲线）；强 OOD 绝对精度仍低（Mix 仅 18.4）。 |
| Test-time Adaptation against Multi-modal Reliability Bias — Yang, Li, Zhang, Hu, Peng, 2024, ICLR | [Paper](https://iclr.cc/virtual/2024/poster/18574) · [Code](https://github.com/XLearning-SCU/2024-ICLR-READ) | test-time-adaptation; quality-aware | READ names the reliability-bias failure of multi-modal TTA (modality-wise shifts make cross-modal reliability uneven) and counters it with self-adaptive attention modulation plus a robust objective that amplifies confident predictions and suppresses noisy ones. | 全文精读：提出并形式化「可靠性偏倚」——一个模态受损后，模态间信息量差距被拉大，朴素融合可能反差于单模态。READ 在测试时双管齐下：(i) 自适应注意力融合——只更新跨模态注意力的 Q/K/V 投影，使注意力向可靠模态重新配权；(ii) 置信感知损失——梯度非单调（高置信样本被放大、低置信样本被反转/抑制，有两个定理支撑），另加类别平衡负熵项。在音视频分类上评测（CAV-MAE；Kinetics50-C / VGGSound-C，每次只腐蚀一个模态，severity 5）：视频受损 Kinetics50-C 62.5（源模型 59.9）；音频受损 VGGSound-C 32.4 对 25.6，而 Tent / MM-TTA 崩至约 4.5 / 7.6。消融显示 SAF 若配普通 Tent 熵损失反不如不适应（雾下 34.9 → 22.7）。仅限分类；要求模型带注意力融合层；无双模同时受损与模态缺失协议。 |
| Inference-Time Intervention (ITI) — Li, Patel, Viégas, Pfister, Wattenberg, 2023, NeurIPS Spotlight | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.03341) | test-time-intervention | Shifts selected attention-head activations along probed directions at inference. | Terminological namesake of "intervention"; LLM-only, one clarifying sentence. |
| MEMO — Zhang, Levine, Finn, 2022, NeurIPS | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09506) | test-time-adaptation | Per-test-point adaptation via marginal entropy over augmentations. | Single-point test-time intervention precedent. |
| MM-TTA: Multi-Modal Test-Time Adaptation for 3D Semantic Segmentation — Shin et al., 2022, CVPR | [Paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2022/html/Shin_MM-TTA_Multi-Modal_Test-Time_Adaptation_for_3D_Semantic_Segmentation_CVPR_2022_paper.html) | test-time-adaptation | Extends test-time adaptation to multi-modal 3D semantic segmentation with intra-modal pseudo-labelling and inter-modal pseudo-label refinement, each modality regularising the other. | CVPR 2022, pp. 16928-16937; also arXiv:2204.12667. Segmentation rather than detection; the canonical multi-modal TTA reference. No official code repository confirmed. |
| Tent — Wang, Shelhamer, Liu, Olshausen, Darrell, 2021, ICLR | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.10726) | test-time-adaptation | Test-time entropy minimization over norm affine parameters. | Canonical "adapt at test time" contrast (parameter-level, unsupervised). |

## Verification Notes

- Links were verified against arXiv, publisher, or proceedings pages on 2026-10-25. Two entries (CMPD, GM-DETR) are recorded with volume/page references where no stable paper URL was verified.
- "TARDet" does not exist under that name in the verified literature; the work is TarDAL (CVPR 2022), included in the main list.
- CMDistill (IEEE JSTARS 2024) could not be independently verified and is excluded.
- Some performance figures in the notes come from comparative tables in other papers (secondary sources); check the original paper before citing a number.
